edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between the Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer.

1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD 40,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), payable by Buyer to Seller at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares free and clear of all liens and encumbrances.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver by the party entitled to the benefit of the applicable condition of the following conditions: receipt of all required regulatory and third-party approvals; absence of any order prohibiting the transaction; and, for Buyer's benefit, Seller's representations being true and correct in all material respects at Closing, Seller's performance of its obligations in all material respects, and delivery of instruments sufficient to transfer the Shares free and clear of all liens and encumbrances. Neither party may waive an approval required by law. Any extension of the Closing date shall require written agreement of the parties.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Seller represents and warrants at signing and at Closing that the financial statements delivered to Buyer have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles consistently applied and fairly present, in all material respects, the Company's financial position and results of operations for the periods stated. Seller further represents and warrants that the Company has no liabilities other than those reflected or reserved against in those financial statements or specifically disclosed in writing to Buyer before signing.

4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless Buyer and, following Closing, the Company against losses, liabilities, damages, and reasonable costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from any breach of Seller's representations, warranties, or covenants or any liability of the Company arising from events occurring before Closing that was not reflected or reserved against in the financial statements or specifically disclosed in writing to Buyer before signing. No party shall recover more than once for the same loss.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Buyer offers USD 46 million as a package with closing within 30 days and no financing condition. We have narrowed the third-party consent condition to consents specifically identified in an agreed signing schedule and accepted customary financial-statement qualifications and an ordinary-course liability exclusion. We also accept indemnification as the exclusive post-closing damages remedy, no standalone pre-closing-liability indemnity, 12-month general representation survival, a 1% deductible basket, and a 10% general cap. edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD 46,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), payable by Buyer to Seller at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares free and clear of all liens and encumbrances.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver by the party entitled to the benefit of the applicable condition of the following conditions: receipt of all regulatory approvals required by applicable law and the third-party consents specifically identified in Schedule 2, which shall be agreed and attached at signing; absence of any order prohibiting the transaction; and, for Buyer's benefit, Seller's representations being true and correct in all material respects at Closing, Seller's performance of its obligations in all material respects, and delivery of instruments sufficient to transfer the Shares free and clear of all liens and encumbrances. Buyer's obligations are not subject to any financing condition. Neither party may waive an approval required by law. Any extension of the Closing date shall require written agreement of the parties.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as specifically disclosed in the disclosure schedules delivered and agreed at signing, Seller represents and warrants at signing and at Closing that the financial statements delivered to Buyer have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles consistently applied and fairly present, in all material respects, the Company's financial position and results of operations for the periods stated; provided that interim financial statements are subject to normal year-end adjustments that are not material individually or in the aggregate and the absence of footnotes. Seller further represents and warrants that the Company has no liabilities other than those reflected or reserved against in those financial statements, specifically disclosed in the disclosure schedules, or incurred in the ordinary course of business consistent with past practice since the date of the most recent balance sheet included in those financial statements; the ordinary-course exception shall not include liabilities arising from breach of contract, tort, or violation of law. Seller further represents and warrants that it has authority to execute and perform this Agreement, owns the Shares free and clear of all liens and encumbrances, and will transfer good title to the Shares at Closing; and that the Shares constitute all issued and outstanding equity interests in the Company, with no outstanding options, warrants, or other rights to acquire equity interests except as specifically disclosed in the disclosure schedules. The representations concerning Seller's authority, title to the Shares, and the Company's capitalization are the “Fundamental Representations.”

4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless Buyer and, following Closing, the Company against losses, liabilities, damages, and reasonable costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from any breach of Seller's representations, warranties, or covenants. There shall be no standalone indemnity for pre-Closing liabilities. Representations and warranties other than Fundamental Representations shall survive Closing for twelve months. Fundamental Representations shall survive Closing for six years. Covenants shall survive in accordance with their terms, and claims for breach thereof may be brought within the applicable limitation period. A claim notified in writing before expiration of the applicable survival period, describing its factual basis and estimated amount to the extent reasonably known, shall survive until finally resolved. Seller shall be liable for breaches of representations and warranties other than Fundamental Representations only to the extent aggregate covered losses exceed 1% of the Purchase Price, and then only for the excess. Seller's aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed 10% of the Purchase Price, except for breaches of Fundamental Representations and Seller's actual fraud. Fundamental Representation claims shall not be subject to the basket and shall be capped at the Purchase Price. Claims based on Seller's actual fraud in making the express representations in this Agreement shall not be subject to the basket, cap, or contractual survival limitations and may be brought within the applicable limitation period; actual fraud requires knowing intentional misrepresentation with intent to induce reliance and actual justifiable reliance and excludes constructive fraud and negligent misrepresentation. Subject to that actual-fraud exception, indemnification under this Section shall be the exclusive post-Closing monetary remedy for claims arising out of this Agreement or the transaction. Nothing herein limits specific performance or other equitable relief to enforce express obligations under this Agreement, but equitable relief shall not be used to circumvent the limitations on monetary recovery in this Section. No party shall recover more than once for the same loss.

Subject to that agreement, we can finalize disclosure schedules and a narrowly limited Schedule 2 covering only specifically agreed, transaction-critical consents, with neither schedule expandable after signing without mutual written consent.
